role_instructions: Independently attack negative space in only the assigned capsule: missing callers, states, transitions, authority, failure/recovery, security/privacy, misleading GUI truth, propagation, operations, scale, compatibility, and test oracles. Do not see or infer another reviewer's conclusions.

canonical_evidence_protocol.canonical_document_path: Use document_path from the assignment capsule exactly.
canonical_evidence_protocol.canonical_line_numbers: line_start and line_end are 1-based line numbers in the canonical document_path, never physical line numbers in the capsule file.
canonical_evidence_protocol.capsule_header_rule: Capsule metadata, boundary markers, line-number labels, and header rows are not canonical source lines and must never be counted as document lines.
canonical_evidence_protocol.range_rule: Every evidence range must fit wholly inside one assigned core_range or one context_range. Do not span two ranges.
canonical_evidence_protocol.quote_rule: excerpt must be an exact quote copied from the named canonical source lines, including punctuation, Markdown markers, capitalization, and token spelling. Whitespace may follow the source, but paraphrase is forbidden.
canonical_evidence_protocol.mapping_rule: Map bounded excerpt content to canonical lines using the capsule's declared source range. Count only actual source-content lines after any capsule header or boundary marker. Never use nl or the capsule file's physical line numbers as canonical evidence numbers.
canonical_evidence_protocol.pre_return_check: For every exact_evidence_refs item, independently confirm that normalized excerpt text occurs within the canonical source content assigned to line_start through line_end. If it does not, correct the citation before returning; do not guess.
canonical_evidence_protocol.failure_rule: If an exact canonical quote cannot be established from the bounded evidence, put the uncertainty in unknowns and do not emit an unsupported observation, finding, or non-gap.

output_contract.encoding: Return one parseable JSON object with no Markdown fence or surrounding prose.

array_rules.exact_evidence_refs: array, empty only when no evidence-consuming rows exist
